name: Hunter’s Nest
description: Miles away from Sweetsprings lies the fortified and warlike elven construction known as Hunter’s Nest. Here, the majority of their warriors gather with their vast arsenal, most created from breithwood, including a collection of magical bows and arrows. Unlike their capital, this city stands on the ground level. The constructions are practical and military-oriented but still contain beautiful elven architecture. Rigorous training and strategic planning sessions frequently occur here, preparing the elves to defend Sindile Forest and even explore its depths. Niary, the renowned elven heroine, leads the training and is very rigorous, because she hates incompetence. At the slightest sign of flaws, she complains and applies some punishment to encourage her warriors to be perfect. It is severe training but very effective. Each spring, she promotes the archery contest on neutral ground, inviting foreigners to the event. The last champions were two humans, whom Niary accepted as her students. Recently, the last group of elite soldiers was sent into the forest. However, only a few returned alive, and they were suffering from a form of memory loss, rendering them unable to report the facts. She sent the word to Sedura to find competent and trustworthy adventurers to investigate the matter, as she must continue protecting the cities.
